description: Submit your hidden move: strike, block, special, or taunt. Strike beats a special windup, block beats strike, and special beats block. Special is legal only when its cooldown is 0 and no previous effect cancels your next move. Robot, Butler, Ghost, and Living Fork wait 2 exchanges after a special; Philippe waits 3. arena_get legalMoves omits special during that wait, and arena_move rejects it with special-on-cooldown instead of recording a whiff. A slip or a skipped turn also refuses special. Optional thought is at most 100 characters and is revealed only after the exchange resolves. If your move does not arrive within 10 minutes it becomes a block. In a practice bout the house bot moves when you do.

thought.description: Optional thought, 100 characters, revealed when the exchange resolves.
